macros.name: C
macros.doc: The most basic usage of this package consists in calling the macro \C in math mode, that prints C1 for the first time, C2 for the second time, ...

macros.name: newconstantfamily
macros.doc: The macro \newconstantfamily allows one to define a new family of constants.

macros.name: resetconstant
macros.doc: The macro \resetconstant set the counter cst@counter@⟨family⟩ to 0.
